description: Scripted Nepal-wide news timeline for deterministic re-optimization demos.

events.text: Major landslide reported in Taplejung. A medical post is damaged and road access is disrupted.
Bridge collapse near Jumla cuts off road access to mountain settlements.
events.demo_note: Confidence requires coordinator review before re-optimization.

events.text: Mahendranagar hospital requests immediate medical supplies after flood displacement.
events.demo_note: High-confidence report triggers automatic plan generation.

events.text: Heard there might be an issue around Bharatpur. No details available.
events.demo_note: Low-confidence report is logged without triggering optimization.

events.text: Flash flood warning issued for Janakpur and Dharan. Rescue teams are mobilizing.
events.demo_note: Demonstrates concurrent incidents across multiple provinces.
